title: COAL pipeline run report (coal.pipeline/1)
description: What `coal pipeline pairs|clusters` writes to <out_dir>/report.json (or --report). The tables it refers to (dnds.tsv, cluster_summary.tsv, genes.tsv, failed.tsv) are described in docs/pipeline.md. A report with "report_truncated": true is the short form written when the disk was full and has only a few of the required keys.

exit_code.description: 0 completed; 2 completed, with failures listed in failed.tsv; 1 the run could not be done; 130 interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT); 128 + signal number when a termination signal ended it (143 for SIGTERM, 129 for SIGHUP)

status.description: interrupted: a signal or Ctrl-C ended the run; the tables in the folder are incomplete or missing, and nothing the run started is left running

started.description: when the run started: UTC, ISO 8601

finished.description: when the report was written: UTC, ISO 8601

threads.description: -j as given (0 = one per CPU), the threads of coal-cpp, and the threads / processes DIAMOND and the aligners were given (neither is more than usable_cpus, the CPUs this process may run on: its affinity)

inputs.description: every file the run read, as given (a gzip-compressed file is described compressed)

sha256.description: null when the file was not hashed: sha256_skipped says why

id_prefix.description: --prefix-ids: what was put before the IDs of this file (its name and |)

cite.description: citation keys for this run (coal cite REPORT.json prints the references; src/coal/citations.py)

warnings.description: the warning lines of the run

report_truncated.description: only in the short report written when the whole one could not be (a full disk): it has schema, coal_version, mode, out_dir, exit_code, status and error only

genetic_code_hints.description: input sets in which genes with internal stop codons under the chosen genetic code have none under another one (docs/pipeline.md, Genes of another genetic code): mitochondrial or plastid genes in a nuclear set, or the wrong -c

file.description: clusters mode: the --cds file the hint is about (each file is judged on its own)

records.description: records of the set (genes.tsv rows, a repeated ID not counted)

genes_looked_at.description: genes with two or more internal stops looked at: all, or at most 5,000 spread evenly over the set

whole_set.description: at least half of the records have internal stops: the hint is about the code of the whole set (run again with another -c), not about organelle genes in it

clean_under.description: the one code that explains the genes best; null when the sequences cannot tell between the candidates

also_clean_under.description: other codes under which these genes have no internal stop either, but that explain them less well

candidates.description: the codes that explain the genes equally well (one: clean_under)

evidence.description: what the choice rests on: the internal stop codons, and avoided codons

isoforms.description: several transcripts per gene (docs/pipeline.md, One record is one gene): what was found in each input set (query, subject or cds) and what --longest-isoform did

commands.description: argv of every external program the stage ran (kept when --resume reuses the stage)

flagged.description: with --min-codons / --max-ds: the pairs each flag marked

dropped.description: with --longest-isoform: records that are not the longest of their gene

outputs.description: The files and folders this run wrote, as paths relative to out_dir. Keys: dnds, genes, failed, and when they apply orthologs, unpaired, clusters, realign, cluster_summary, kaks (--kaks-format), codon_alignments (--keep-alignments: codon_alignments.fasta in pair mode, the folder codon_alignments in cluster mode), protein_alignments (--keep-protein-alignments: protein_alignments.fasta, or the folder protein_alignments, with the same records in the same order as codon_alignments)

commands.description: the exact command lines (argv arrays) this run, or the earlier run a stage was reused from, started the tool with

command_template.description: Clustal Omega / MAFFT run once per cluster (or pair): the command of one run, with IN.fasta / OUT.fasta for the temporary files
